## Expected and actual behaviour / 预期与实际

Describe the task boundary and the gate involved. 说明任务边界及对应过程门。

## Reproduction / 复现

Include package commit/version, Python/OS, mode and the shortest redacted command sequence.
提供版本、运行环境、模式与最短脱敏复现步骤。

## Evidence / 证据

Include exit codes, relevant output and snapshot-change behaviour. Do not post raw run directories, private paths, source code without permission, prompts, credentials or personal approval records.
提供退出码、相关输出和快照变化；不要上传未脱敏的运行目录或私人材料。

## Scope of the result / 结果边界

Was this an observed execution, a hypothetical concern, or a documentation mismatch?
说明是实际运行结果、待验证风险，还是文档与实现不一致。
